attempted_claim: Every 3-generated finite idempotent algebra A with |A|<=16 such that V(A) is congruence distributive admits Jonsson terms of length at most 3, i.e., is 3-distributive under the standard inclusive length convention.
claim_type: generation-bounded structural collapse to short Maltsev terms
decisive_failure: No certified counterexample and no collapse proof obtained. Searched windows cover random baked length-5 chains on 3-4 elements, quotient-lift algebras, all 54 subuniverses of one lead algebra squared, and sampled A-cubed subs; the full class of 3-generated idempotent CD algebras up to size 16 remains undecided. Clone-exact certification was computationally infeasible (clones exceeding 200K terms without closing).
